# Vasanth Shetty - Premium Custom Web Development

> Custom Web Development for Small Service Businesses & Freelancers.
> High-performance, custom-coded websites and landing pages built by a solo developer.

## Overview
Vasanth Shetty builds fast, custom-coded websites, landing pages, custom booking systems, and small e-commerce sites tailored for service businesses. 100% code ownership, zero recurring platform fees, and lightning-fast load times.

## Core Offerings, Timelines & Pricing

### 1. Starter Site (1-3 Pages)
- Timeline: 1 - 2 Weeks
- Pricing / Investment: ~A$1,000 / NZ$1,100 / EUR 625 / S$1,000 / kr 7,900
- Key Deliverables: Single page or 1-3 page responsive brochure site, 1 contact form integration, basic on-page SEO setup, mobile-first design.

### 2. Small Business Standard (5-8 Pages)
- Timeline: 2 - 3 Weeks
- Pricing / Investment: ~A$3,100 / NZ$3,350 / EUR 1,950 / S$2,650 / kr 21,250
- Key Deliverables: 5-8 bespoke pages (Home, About, Services, Contact, etc.), local SEO setup, Google Business linkage, lead capture & analytics.

### 3. Growth / Custom Site (8-15 Pages)
- Timeline: 3 - 4 Weeks
- Pricing / Investment: ~A$5,800 / NZ$6,400 / EUR 3,600 / S$4,900 / kr 39,500
- Key Deliverables: 8-15 bespoke pages, blog / CMS / resources section, third-party integrations (booking, newsletter, social), advanced technical SEO foundation.

## Core Value Proposition
1. **High Conversion Rate**: Sites built to turn traffic into booked appointments and qualified leads.
2. **Mobile-First**: Flawless touch target ergonomics and responsive UI across all devices.
3. **SEO Focused**: Technical SEO best practices built directly into the codebase.
4. **100% Code Ownership**: Full source code transferred upon completion. No platform lock-in.
